messages:
Anya (PM): quick sync — we need to lock the v1 -> v2 route deprecation plan for chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, and tool calling. proposing 6-month runway, phased: docs + sdk migration tools (month 0-2), canary traffic + telemetry (2-4), gradual cutoff w/ hard-deprecate at month 6. thoughts?
Maya (Eng): +1 on phases. we should keep v1 read-only for embeddings for longer if customers depend on exact vector formats.
Priya (ML): agreed. some older models in v1 have subtle tokenization differences that affect embedding dim and quality. recommend compatibility bridge for embeddings for 3 months after chat cutoff.
Jon (Eng Platform): need clear gating metrics for each phase. propose: error rate <= 0.5%, no major regression in embedding similarity on 10 customer benchmarks, and no rollback requests in canary cohort for 72h.
Sam (DevEx): I'll draft migration snippets and a small CLI to rewrite client calls. dev preview package published to pip/npm in phase 1.
Anya (PM): concrete ask: list of launch criteria for each surface (chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, tool calling, structured output) + doc owner + SDK tasks. I'll own prioritization.
Maya (Eng): technical notes:
```
- Chat/completions: v2 merges chat+completion semantics. need request/response backward adapter.
- Tool calling: v2 unified `tools` schema; v1 uses older `functions` payload. adapter mapping required.
```
We can do adapter in the gateway to reduce customer churn.
Priya (ML): structured output: v2 enforces schema validation by default. we need a compatibility flag `schema_strict=false` for v1->v2 bridge.
Jon (Eng Platform): routing plan: add a routing policy that sends 5% traffic to v2 by default for customers with `auto_migrate=true`. allow per-customer feature flag in console.
Sam (DevEx): docs: include quick diff table, example transforms, and a migration checklist with post-migration validation queries. I'll include sample eval scripts.
Anya (PM): customer-driven asks: two large customers asked for no forced change to embeddings dim + an audit log for function-calling. we should surface both as blockers if we can't meet them.
Maya (Eng): audit logs for tool calls is infra work but doable. embeddings dim: we can provide a compatibility mode that returns same vector length and a warning header. not ideal long-term but buys time.
Priya (ML): for rerank: make sure score scales are consistent. v1 used cosine pre-normalized, v2 may expose raw logits. we need a shim to normalize scores for rerank endpoints.
Jon (Eng Platform): telemetry: define events -> migration_started, migration_completed, fallback_triggered, adapter_error. hook into Console and alerting. we need dashboards before canary.
Anya (PM): deprecation timeline draft:
- Month 0: announce deprecation, publish migration guide, preview SDKs.
- Month 1-2: docs + CLI + adapter released; customer migrations start.
- Month 3: enable canary for 5-10% of traffic; monitor metrics.
- Month 4-5: ramp to 50% for willing customers; force-flag for opt-in migrations.
- Month 6: v1 soft-shutdown: 403 for new API keys; 12 more months of read-only for embeddings only. hard-deprecate after 18 months.
Maya (Eng): can we compress that if metrics look great? maybe 4 months total. but schedule must allow enterprise signoffs.
Anya (PM): we'll keep flexibility. action item: decide final timeline by EOW.
Sam (DevEx): migration checklist items I'll own:
- SDK release notes + code mods
- automated PR codemod for common patterns (chat->v2 chat request)
- sample eval harness for embeddings diff
- blog post + deprecation FAQ
Maya (Eng): engineering tasks:
- gateway adapter for v1 payloads -> v2 runtime (owner: @Maya)
- feature flagging per-customer (owner: @Jon)
- audit logs for tool calls (owner: @Maya)
Jon (Eng Platform): infra tasks:
- telemetry events and dashboards (owner: @Jon)
- canary traffic controller + rollback hook (owner: @Jon)
Priya (ML): model tasks:
- verify embedding dims across model catalog, add compatibility bridge for legacy models (owner: @Priya)
- rerank score normalization tests (owner: @Priya)
Anya (PM): risk log: customers with on-prem/private deployments might not upgrade on timeline — need explicit enterprise outreach and extended support path.
Maya (Eng): propose a migration header from runtime: `X-Redwood-Migration: v2-adapter` so we can track adapter use.
Jon (Eng Platform): also add SDK opt-in telemetry to see which clients use the codemod.
Sam (DevEx): I'll coordinate a customer preview cohort. who should we invite? CC: @Priya for ML-critical customers, @Jon for platform folks.
Priya (ML): I'll propose 3 customers with heavy embeddings usage.
Anya (PM): finalize owners and timeline today, Sam to schedule preview kickoff. final decision: we will keep embeddings read-only after chat cutoff and offer a 12-month extended compatibility window for on-prem customers.
deploy-bot: planned deployment: gateway-adapter/v1-compat-2026-03-21 -> scheduled for canary on 1763460000.
Maya (Eng): noted. I'll start the adapter PR and include unit tests for score normalization and schema flag.
Jon (Eng Platform): I'll spin up dashboards and the canary controller. ETA 2 weeks.
Sam (DevEx): I'll draft the migration guide and codemod this week and post a preview in #devex-beta.
Anya (PM): thanks all — next sync Thu 11am to lock timeline. I'll post the decision doc and owners after this thread. :white_check_mark:
